تستثمرن (form X)

# تُسْتَثْمَرْنَ (tustaṯmarna) /tus.taθ.mar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
